The HappyProto command line

Usage: hpy [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  registry   Work with the HappyProto plugin registry
  update     Update hpy to the newest release on your channel
  channel    Show or choose the release channel hpy updates from
  happyview  Build HappyView apps: a project directory, run and tested locally
  help       Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --json      Print the result as JSON on stdout
      --no-input  Never prompt; fail when a value is missing. Irreversible actions still need --yes.
                  Implied without a terminal
  -C <DIR>        Run as if started in DIR
  -h, --help      Print help
  -V, --version   Print version
